---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new idea, capability, or improvement for the project
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: feature, enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem or use case

Describe the problem this feature would solve. Example: "I cannot tell whether the API returns `403` instead of `429` when it throttles..."

## Proposed solution

Describe the desired behavior and how it should work in the application.

## Area and technical impact

Which area does this affect?

- [ ] Domain or application layer
- [ ] HTTP client / transport
- [ ] Metrics or reporting
- [ ] Qt interface / design system
- [ ] Packaging or CI/CD
- [ ] Documentation or governance

Describe expected changes to architecture, dependencies, tests, or configuration.

## Alternatives considered

Describe any alternative solutions, workarounds, or tools you considered.

## Visual prototype

Attach layout sketches, diagrams, or conceptual images when useful.

## Additional context

Add use cases, target API behavior, or references that justify the request. Do not include secrets or unauthorized endpoints.
